newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Motorola unit to build Israel research facility.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit to build Israel research facility.

text.p: Motorola Semiconductor Israel said on Thursday it would build a research and development facility in the southern part of the country.
The company, a subsidiary of Motorola Corp, said it would spend $9 million in the next three years building the facility near Ben Gurion university in Beersheba.

"We feel that in the southern part of the country there is a growing pool of university graduates and we hope to recruit dozens of engineers in the first year," said Israel Keshet, managing director of Motorola Semiconductor Israel.
The company manufactures advanced processors for Motorola and announced recently it was working on a multi-media processor designed to run 40 times faster than existing ones.
